summary: Comprehensive testing of Project UNIFY - internship & placement management platform. Backend API testing achieved 92.9% success rate with 26/28 tests passing. Frontend testing confirmed all major features working including landing page, authentication, role-based dashboards, and AI-powered job recommendations.

flaky_endpoints.note: Likely due to httpOnly cookie authentication requirement vs Bearer token

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix authentication mechanism for API endpoints - applications and recommendations endpoints return 403 when using Bearer tokens. The frontend works correctly with httpOnly cookies, but API testing with Bearer tokens fails. Consider supporting both authentication methods or update API documentation.
